official_hf_route: InternVL3.5 custom chat code, full BF16, CUDA device 0, FlashAttention enabled
gguf_route: llama.cpp built from source with CUDA 13.2, FlashAttention, and sm_120
notes: The dynamic-module cache is seeded with the snapshot's Python support files before custom-code loading.
Run one model at a time after python3 src/executor.py release-local.
The llama.cpp source build uses MAX_JOBS=4 and NVCC_THREADS=1 from ~/.bashrc.
